tweets.text:
JUST ANOTHER DAY SHUTTING DOWN ILLEGAL ACTIVITY! 

USBP agents attempted to stop a Chevy Silverado suspected of smuggling people in Laredo, TX. The driver thought he could outrun law enforcement, BUT AirOps kept eyes on the vehicle and when it finally stopped, three people jumped out in an attempt to evade arrest- all three were immediately apprehended. A human smuggling scout was also arrested for his involvement.
All are facing charges. 

And here's the kicker- the truck was stolen and running on cloned license plates. TX DPS took possession of the vehicle.

@USBPChiefLRT @texas_dps @CBPAMO
